---
title: "Examples"
subtitle: "Short snippets showing each module at work."
description: "Working snippets for the colour, string, lookup, and path modules, with the output each one gives."
---

Each snippet loads the module from `_vendor/quarto-lua-modules/`, as described in the [vendoring guide](vendoring.qmd).
The output shown is the value the function returns, checked by running the code on the `main` branch.

## Escape text for HTML

Escape a user value before you place it in raw HTML.

```lua
local str = require(quarto.utils.resolve_path('_vendor/quarto-lua-modules/string.lua'):gsub('%.lua$', ''))
local safe = str.escape_html('Hello <World>')
```

`safe` is `Hello &lt;World&gt;`.

## Trim and split a value

Read a comma-separated option, and clean each entry.

```lua
local str = require(quarto.utils.resolve_path('_vendor/quarto-lua-modules/string.lua'):gsub('%.lua$', ''))
local parts = str.split('a.b.c', '.')
local trimmed = str.trim('  hello world  ')
```

`parts` is `{'a', 'b', 'c'}`, and `trimmed` is `hello world`.

## Convert a colour

Turn a three-digit hex colour into six digits, and an RGB value into hex.

```lua
local colour = require(quarto.utils.resolve_path('_vendor/quarto-lua-modules/colour.lua'):gsub('%.lua$', ''))
local hex = colour.expand_hex_colour('#123')
local red = colour.RGB_to_HTML('rgb(255, 0, 0)')
```

`hex` is `#112233`, and `red` is `#FF0000`.

## Map a keyword to a CSS value

Accept a size keyword from a shortcode argument, and pass a raw CSS value through unchanged.

```lua
local lookup = require(quarto.utils.resolve_path('_vendor/quarto-lua-modules/lookup.lua'):gsub('%.lua$', ''))
local css = lookup.size_to_css('large')
```

`css` is `font-size: 1.2em;`.

## Check a path

Test the file type of a document path before you read it.

```lua
local paths = require(quarto.utils.resolve_path('_vendor/quarto-lua-modules/paths.lua'):gsub('%.lua$', ''))
local is_markdown = paths.is_markdown('doc.qmd')
```

`is_markdown` is `true`.
